required_measurements: Actual bench dimensions, thickness/material and rear/underside access
Clamp model, pad dimensions/rating and available spacing; cable/connector keepouts
Installed nozzle, slicer/version, machine/material profiles and actual filament formulations
Sliced per-part mass/COM proxy, print orientation and support/skin/perimeter details
Measured holes, mating diameters, runout, retention and repeatable remount transform
